title: PostgreSQL
description: PostgreSQL reference covering schema design, types, constraints, queries, indexes, transactions, MVCC, locking, JSONB, full-text search, partitioning, security, backup, replication, tuning, and diagnostics.

subtopics.title: Types, Keys & Integrity
subtopics.description: Use the narrowest semantic type and encode invariants with primary, foreign, unique, not-null, exclusion, and check constraints.

table.title: Common PostgreSQL Type Selection
rows: Store instant; render in user zone

codeBlocks.code:
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),
  status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','paid','cancelled')),
  total numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (total >= 0),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

subtopics.title: Normalization, Arrays & JSONB
subtopics.description: Normalize authoritative entities and relationships; use arrays/JSONB for bounded document attributes whose access and integrity requirements fit.

callouts.title: JSONB Is Not a Free Schema Escape
callouts.text: Frequent joins, uniqueness, foreign keys, and field updates usually belong in columns/tables. Document JSON shape and index only queried paths.

subtopics.title: Joins, Aggregates, Windows & CTEs
subtopics.description: Use joins for relationships, GROUP BY for row reduction, window functions for analytics without collapse, and CTEs for clarity or explicit materialization.

codeBlocks.code:
SELECT customer_id, created_at, total,
       sum(total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at) AS running_total
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid';

subtopics.title: B-tree, GIN, GiST, BRIN & EXPLAIN
subtopics.description: Index predicates, joins, ordering, and constraints from real workloads. Column order, selectivity, correlation, and write cost determine usefulness.

codeBlocks.code:
CREATE INDEX orders_customer_created_idx ON orders (customer_id, created_at DESC) INCLUDE (total) WHERE status = 'paid';
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT ...;

callouts.title: EXPLAIN ANALYZE Executes the Query
callouts.text: Use care with writes and expensive production queries. Start with EXPLAIN and reproduce safely when possible.

subtopics.title: Isolation Levels, Row Locks & Deadlocks
subtopics.description: MVCC gives statement snapshots while writes still lock. Pick isolation from anomalies, lock rows in consistent order, and retry serialization/deadlock failures.

table.title: PostgreSQL Isolation
rows: Stable multi-query view; retry serialization failures

subtopics.title: UPSERT, SKIP LOCKED & Connection Pools
subtopics.description: Use ON CONFLICT for atomic insert/update, SKIP LOCKED for competing database workers, and bounded pools sized to database capacity.

callouts.title: More Connections Can Reduce Throughput
callouts.text: Oversized pools increase contention and memory. Budget connections across replicas, jobs, migrations, admin, and failover.

subtopics.title: VACUUM, Backup, Replication & Migrations
subtopics.description: Autovacuum reclaims dead tuples and protects transaction IDs; backups require restore tests; streaming replicas are asynchronous; migrations need lock-aware rollout.

codeBlocks.code:
SELECT * FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle';
SELECT relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC;

subtopics.title: Security, Monitoring & Checklist
subtopics.description: Use roles, least privilege, TLS, parameterized queries, statement/lock timeouts, query statistics, capacity alarms, and tested recovery.

callouts.title: Production Checklist
callouts.text: Enforce constraints, index from plans, keep transactions short, bound pools, set timeouts, monitor locks/bloat/replication lag, test backups, version migrations, and use expand-contract deploys.
